summary.description: One or two sentences: what was reviewed and the overall verdict.

findings.description: Every finding that is still open after this review, including ones carried over from the previous review.

kind.description: The category of the finding, one from this list (other when none fits). Repeated kinds across PRs become proposed agent rules (ADR-0097).

scenario.description: Concrete failing scenario (input → wrong result) or the exact rule broken (ADR, contract, AGENTS.md line).

resolved.description: Previous findings that no longer hold, each as "title: why" (fixed in a commit, or the reply that settled it).
